categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in two main business segments: kitchen foods and feed raw materials & oleochemical technology. Kitchen foods include edible oils, rice, flour, noodles, condiments, and food ingredients for household and industrial use. Feed raw materials and oleochemical technology cover soybean meal, bran, rice bran meal, and oleochemical products derived from palm oil and other oils, including basic and derivative oleochemicals, nutritional products, and daily chemical products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced processing technologies such as oilseed crushing, oil refining, oil filling, specialized oils, and oleochemical technology. It utilizes a 'circular economy' model for resource utilization, including rice husk power generation and extraction of high-value by-products. The company also emphasizes technology-driven innovation in fermentation, plant protein functional nutrition, seasoning fermentation, and fresh rice precision control technologies. It integrates digitalization, automation, and smart manufacturing to enhance production efficiency and product quality.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves a broad customer base including retail consumers, catering and food industry clients, large supermarket chains, restaurant chains, food processing enterprises, and daily chemical product users. Its products cater to household kitchens, commercial catering, and industrial food production. The company also supplies feed raw materials to livestock and poultry farming sectors. Major customers include well-known domestic and international enterprises, with a strong presence in both consumer and industrial markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within China, with extensive production bases strategically located near raw material sources, ports, railways, and end markets across multiple provinces and cities such as Shanghai, Tianjin, Qingdao, Changsha, and others. It also has limited overseas operations and exports, with a small portion of revenue derived from international markets. The parent company is based in Hong Kong, and some subsidiaries operate in Singapore and other regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple points in the agricultural and food supply chain, including upstream raw material processing (oilseed crushing, grain milling), midstream food processing (refining, packaging), and downstream product distribution and sales. It integrates vertically by managing raw material procurement, processing, product manufacturing, and marketing, positioning itself as a comprehensive food processing and supply enterprise.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening the kitchen foods and feed raw materials & oleochemical technology businesses, expanding product lines, and enhancing brand value. The company focuses on R&D in plant protein nutrition, fermentation technology for seasonings, fresh rice processing, and oleochemical innovations. It invests in smart manufacturing, digital transformation, and sustainable development aligned with national carbon neutrality goals. The company also emphasizes consumer health trends, product innovation, and channel expansion.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of physical products including edible oils, rice, flour, noodles, condiments, feed raw materials, and oleochemical products. The company uses a combination of direct sales and distribution via dealers and retailers. It also earns income from related services such as leasing and investment returns. Derivative financial instruments are used for hedging commodity and currency risks, impacting investment income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading player in China's edible oil and grain processing industry, holding top brand positions such as 'Golden Dragon Fish' which has been the leading edible oil brand for 13 consecutive years. It competes with other major food processing enterprises in China, leveraging its integrated supply chain, strong brand portfolio, and extensive distribution network. The company is recognized for its innovation, quality, and sustainability leadership in the sector.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 251.5 billion, a slight decrease of 2.3% year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 2.85 billion, down 5.4%. Despite revenue and profit declines due to raw material price drops and market competition, the company maintains a large asset base of RMB 238.5 billion and continues to invest in capacity expansion and innovation. Cash flow from operations significantly improved, indicating strong liquidity and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes providing nutritious, healthy, safe, and high-quality food products with a comprehensive brand matrix covering high-end to mass-market segments. It differentiates through advanced processing technologies, integrated supply chain efficiencies, and a strong focus on food safety and quality control. Its 'Golden Dragon Fish' brand is highly recognized for quality and innovation, supported by continuous R&D and sustainable practices. The company also offers customized products for diverse consumer needs and channels, enhancing customer loyalty and market competitiveness.
